name: computed-import-directory
description: A load whose path is computed, an import() or require() whose template or concatenation starts with a relative literal naming a directory other than the calling file's own, roots every source file below that directory with its exports, as a bundler's context module loads them; a computed path whose literal start is the calling file's own directory roots nothing. The computed import of its own directory loads a file the analysis cannot resolve, so the report notes it.
